text.en: 1. This Act is the Good Samaritan Food Donation Act 2024 and comes into operation on a date that the Minister appoints by notification in the Gazette.

3. The purpose of this Act is to encourage food donations —
(a)to reduce food waste; and
(b)to increase availability of food for redistribution to food‑insecure communities.

heading.en: Waiver of criminal and civil liability

text.en:
5.—(1) Section 4 does not apply in relation to liability arising before the commencement of that section.
(2) This Act does not apply to —
(a)any exchanging or giving of food between individuals as part of a personal relationship; or
(b)any supply of food together with accommodation to an individual residing at a private residence in exchange for services or labour by the individual.
